findings.description: i2c_dev is dereferenced implicitly via Adafruit_I2CRegister without any prior null check.
The code does not check whether the I2C read operation succeeds.
The C-style cast to HUSB238_5VCurrentContract bypasses type safety.
Values read from hardware are external/untrusted inputs.
